claims.source_quote_ar: نزلت في الخمر أربع آيات نزلت بمكة
claims.claim_ar: تكرار فعل الجذر ن-ز-ل (أُنْزِلَ) في صياغة الآية يخلق وزنًا إيقاعياً وتأكيدًا على صفة "الوحي المنزّل"، وهو بديع من نوع التكرار.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the verb root n-z-l (أُنْزِلَ) in the verse creates a rhythmic echo and strengthens emphasis on the attribute 'revealed', a badi' device of repetition (takrar).
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting source substring shows repetition of نزلت in a different exegetical context (Zamakhshari's discussion). It is an indirect attestation of the rhetorical effect rather than a commentary on this exact verse; verify with a source that explicitly comments on repetition in S2:A4.
claims.rhetorical_effect: strengthens the theme of divine revelation and creates rhythmic emphasis

claims.source_quote_ar: من لطائف الحكم التي تعجز عن أوصافها الألسن
claims.claim_ar: الآية تُنسب إلى لطائف الحكم التي تدل على إعجاز القرآن وإيجاز بلاغته؛ أي أن صياغتها موجزة ومعبرة مما يندرج تحت إعجاز (إعجاز بلاغي/إيجاز).
claims.claim_en: The verse belongs to the subtle wisdoms that defy description, indicating Qur'anic rhetorical inimitability and concision (ijaaz). The formulation is compact and semantically dense, a hallmark of rhetorical i'jaz.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted tafsir passage (Tabari) makes a general statement about the Qur'an's 'subtle wisdoms'; it does not analyze this specific verse's concision. Claim links general tafsir judgement to this ayah and should be checked against a focused balagha commentary on S2:A4.
claims.rhetorical_effect: compresses theological claims into a compact, memorable statement enhancing memorability and perceived authority

claims.source_quote_ar: اقتران هذا السؤال بالواو ليرتبط بالأول.
claims.claim_ar: استخدام العطف بالواو لربط مقاطع المعنى (وَ... وََ...) يعطي تتابعًا وترابطًا بلاغيًا بين عناصر الإيمان في الآية؛ وهو من معاني الفاصل والوصل (فسل ووصل) حيث الواو تربط وتؤكد التسلسل.
claims.claim_en: The conjunction waw links clauses and creates rhetorical continuity and emphasis between the elements of belief in the verse. This is a ma'ani device of separation-and-connection (fasl_wasl), where waw both connects and highlights sequence.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting substring (Zamakhshari on the function of the waw) discusses conjunction in a different exegetical context (questions joined by waw). Application to the rhetorical function of waw in S2:A4 is an inference and should be corroborated by a philological/balagha source explicitly treating the waw in this verse.
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates cohesion among listed beliefs and lends cumulative force to the description of the believers
